scope: Credential identity and lifecycle only. These records are not technical question sources, independent question attestations, or permission to open either gameplay mode.
reason: The current official credential establishes the SC-500 identity and preparation scope, but the retrieved rendered metadata and public catalog/hierarchy records provide no explicit beta/GA lifecycle value. Official Partner Center announcements establish an availability date, not an explicit general-availability declaration. Scheduling availability, the absence of a beta title, a passed calendar date, and the unavailable practice assessment are not substituted for positive lifecycle verification.

evidence.title: Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate
evidence.supportingSummary: The credential names the security-engineer certification, references SC-500 preparation, and states that its practice assessment is not yet available. Its generic explanation of usual assessment timing after beta does not establish this exam's current lifecycle.

evidence.title: Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate — rendered metadata
evidence.supportingSummary: Rendered metadata identifies certification.cloud-and-ai-security-engineer-associate. The page offers scheduling for exam.SC-500 but contains no explicit isBeta or GA lifecycle declaration. No booking or authenticated account access was performed.

evidence.title: July 2026 announcements
evidence.supportingSummary: The July 30 specialization-skilling announcement identifies SC-500 as the replacement for retiring AZ-500 and gives July 21, 2026 as its availability date. This verifies the announced replacement and availability date, but the captured section does not explicitly classify SC-500 as out of beta or generally available.

evidence.title: August 2026 announcements
evidence.supportingSummary: The August 31 skilling update states that SC-500 replaced AZ-500 and was available as of July 21, 2026. It corroborates the replacement and availability date without an explicit current beta/GA declaration.

metadataChecks.description: A bounded public Learn Catalog API query returned the requested credential and an empty exams array; no lifecycle value was supplied.
The public certification hierarchy returned the matching UID and an empty exams array; it did not establish a beta/GA value.

nextStep: Independently establish SC-500's positively documented current non-beta lifecycle before changing its catalog status or enabling Study or Gauntlet. Then rerun all normal content, ledger, source, coverage and readiness gates. No GH-600 beta-play exception applies.
